\caption{\textbf{Qualitative comparison at 13 \nfe} (\flux, DrawBench, $\delta = 0.6$, $3.8\times$ fewer transformer evaluations than the 50-step reference). The prompts are selected by a fixed rule, not by hand: among the 182 of 200 prompts on which \seacache, \kalsea and \ours computed the identical set of steps, we compute the per-prompt PSNR gain of \ours over \seacache and show the prompt whose gain is closest to the median (+1.17\,dB; left) and the one closest to the upper quartile (+2.38\,dB; right). Below each image, a fixed $256\times128$-pixel crop (of $1024\times1024$) is magnified; it is placed where the three accelerated samples differ most from one another (largest mean pairwise absolute difference), without looking at the reference.
